notes: Every figure here is the Chief Electoral Officer's as reported in the press. The state figures come from ETV Bharat's account of the press conference on the final roll on 21 September 2026, checked against The Hindu, and the district and constituency figures from the Hindustan Times and the Times of India in July 2026.
The Chief Electoral Officer's website, which carries a constituency analysis of the draft roll, could not be reached, so no full table below the state was read.
The roll before is the roll of 17 May 2026. The five reasons add exactly to the 20,12,557 names left off. Shifted, absent or other is 1,99,249 absent, 8,08,205 shifted and 14,441 other.
The 44,777 names removed after the draft are 24,070 found ineligible at a hearing and 20,707 removed on Form 7 objections. ETV Bharat prints 20,708 for the second, one more than the other reports.
The notices figure is ETV Bharat's, 12,98,779 unmapped electors and 45,37,547 with a logical discrepancy. The New Indian Express gives 45,37,613 for the second and 58,36,392 in all, 66 more.
The Hindustan Times gives district percentages on the roll of 1 January 2025, which is not the roll the revision started from, so only its counts are used.
